note: Counts describing responses.parquet, which is 235 MB and lives under ~/codrona-data/ rather than in the repository. This file is the committed half: it is what a reviewer can read and what --verify-current compares a fresh build against. No timestamp, because a wall-clock field would make every regeneration a diff and destroy the one property a committed artefact has - that regenerating it and finding no change means nothing moved.
